app.name: Wii Moonlight
app.long_description:
ALPHA VERSION - very early in development. Expect bugs, freezes and crashes.
Wii Moonlight streams games and your desktop from a PC running Sunshine to the Wii, using the Moonlight protocol.
Features: - Finds Sunshine PCs on your network automatically, or enter the IP address yourself - Pairing with an on-screen PIN - 360p (recommended) or 480p video, stereo audio - Wii Remote as mouse (IR pointer) and gamepad, with Nunchuk support
Setup: in Sunshine's web UI, set FEC to 50. A wired (Ethernet) connection works best.
Please report bugs on GitHub and include moonlight.log from this app's folder on the SD card.
Licensed under GPLv3. Based on Moonlight Embedded and moonlight-common-c.
